events.title: Artifacts, Weapon Loadouts and Cosmic Menus

Discoveries and weapon ranks survive Prestige. Artifact carriers: Hunt down a distinctive scavenger and defeat it to recover your next artifact. Hits slow its escape and rattle its cargo. events.title: The Soliton Burst demo is live
events.summary: The Soliton Burst demo is live on Steam! An arena shooter where the arena keeps folding into new shapes and your weapons follow the geometry. Play the demo and wishlist the full game: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4730300/

events.title: Traditional Chinese is now available
events.summary: Traditional Chinese is now available across the complete Soliton Burst interface: menus, settings, characters, upgrades, achievements, Star Map, bounties, bosses, and in-run guidance. The game follows your Steam language automatically, or you can switch it under Options → Display → Language. If you find awkward wording, clipping, or untranslated text, please use the in-game Feedback button.

events.title: Simplified Chinese is now available
events.summary: Full Simplified Chinese interface support is now available in Soliton Burst.This update localizes more than 1,400 strings across menus, settings, characters, weapon and upgrade descriptions, achievements, the Star Map, bounties, bosses, and in-run guidance. events.title: The playtest is live. Play it now through July 26.
events.summary: It's open. Soliton Burst is a survivors-like where the arena doesn't stay flat. Mid-run the ground folds into a torus, then a Möbius strip, a hyperbolic plane, a wormhole. There's no edge to run to. The world curves back on itself and you keep fighting on the warped space.The playtest is live right now and closes Sunday, July 26. events.title: Folded into Steam Bullet Fest 2026
events.summary: Hi. I've been building Soliton Burst on my own for a while now, and this is its first time at a Steam fest. Bullet Fest 2026 runs 8-15 June and kicks off Monday at 10am Pacific.The pitch: it's a survivors-like where the arena keeps folding into something new. Torus. Möbius strip. Klein bottle. Helicoid.
